identified_root_cause.reasoning: inventory-svc was the first service to exhibit error rate spike (0% → 85% at T+8s). Temporal correlation shows downstream failures (checkout-svc at T+25s, api-gateway at T+42s) followed inventory-svc failure.

missed_patterns.description: Pipeline identified inventory-svc as root cause (correct service) but could not identify that the root cause was capacity/index subsystem failure within the service. RCA stopped at service level, not resource level.

Pipeline did not detect the recovery-then-re-failure pattern (T+2min: 30% error → T+3min: 80% error). The restart attempt made things worse because the index rebuild consumed resources, but pipeline treated each failure independently.
payment-svc was affected (queue depth grew) but pipeline did not detect this because only HTTP error rate is monitored, not internal queue metrics.

comparison_with_expected.cascading_pattern_detected: partial — individual alerts fired but not correlated as single cascading incident
gaps: GAP-1: No resource-level RCA — pipeline cannot distinguish between 'service down' vs 'capacity exhaustion' vs 'dependency failure' within a service
GAP-2: No cascading failure correlation — 7 individual alerts fired instead of 1 correlated incident with dependency chain
